items.description: Combined laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The swerve and impact are covered under §§2.6.2–2.6.3 and 4.5.2, and direct payment to the shop does not change cover under §7.1.12. Comparable screen and housing repairs support about €810 + €360 = €1,170 gross under §7.1.10, with no stated deductible or lower cap.
